test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average runs of a cricket player in 20 matches is 30. If the average of the first 12 matches is 40, find the average of the last 8 matches.
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of matches = 20

Total average runs = 30

**Formula used:**

Average = (sum of observation)/(total number of observation)

Calculation**:**

 By using the formula of average we can calculate the total runs scored by player in 20 matches

⇒ **Total runs = Average runs × Total number of matches**

⇒ Total runs = 30 × 20

⇒ Total runs = 600

Similarly, we can calculate the total runs scored by the player in the first 12 matches,

⇒ R₁₂ = Average runs × Total number of matches

⇒ R12 = 40 × 12 = 480

**The difference between the total runs and total runs in the first 12 matches will give the total runs scored by the player in the last 8 matches**,

⇒ Total runs in last 8 matches = 600 - 480

⇒ Total runs in last 8 matches = 600 - 480 = 120

By using the formula of average,

⇒ Average = (120)/(8)

⇒ Average = 15 runs

**The average of the last 8 matches is 15 runs. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Average = 30,

Extra runs in first 12 matches = 12 × 10 =120 

This means that the average of the remaining 8 matches will be less by 120 runs, only then the common average will be 30 

⇒ Total runs in last 8 matches = 30 -(120/8) = 30 -15 =15
